statement:
∀ x ∈ Ioo 0 2,
  ∀ (ε : ℝ),
    0 < ε →
      0 < x * Real.exp (-x) ∧
        (∃ y ∈ Ioo 0 2, y * Real.exp (-y) < x * Real.exp (-x)) ∧ ∃ y ∈ Ioo 0 2, y * Real.exp (-y) < ε
script:
# name: set-x-exp-no-min-test
# technique: test fallback (test_fallback recipe): instances the kernel checks, chosen by hand
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Sets.Compact.x_exp_no_min
# description: the claim at the instances below, each proved independently of the claim
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['1', '(by constructor <;> norm_num)', '1/2', '(by norm_num)'], True, 'have key : ∀ (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 2) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε), 0 < x * Real.exp (-x) ∧ (∃ y ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 2, y * Real.exp (-y) < x * Real.exp (-x)) ∧ ∃ y ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 2, y * Real.exp (-y) < ε := by
  intro x hx ε hε
  have hf : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → y * Real.exp (-y) < y := fun y hy => by
    have : Real.exp (-y) < 1 := Real.exp_lt_one_iff.2 (by linarith)
    nlinarith
  have hpos : 0 < x * Real.exp (-x) := mul_pos hx.1 (Real.exp_pos _)
  refine ⟨hpos, ⟨min (x * Real.exp (-x)) 1 / 2, ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩, ?_⟩,
    ⟨min ε 1 / 2, ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩, ?_⟩⟩
  · have := min_le_right (x * Real.exp (-x)) 1; linarith
  · have h1 := hf (min (x * Real.exp (-x)) 1 / 2) (by positivity)
    have h2 := min_le_left (x * Real.exp (-x)) 1
    linarith
  · have := min_le_right ε 1; linarith
  · have h1 := hf (min ε 1 / 2) (by positivity)
    have h2 := min_le_left ε 1
    linarith
exact @key (1) ((by constructor <;> norm_num)) (1/2) ((by norm_num))'),
    (['1/10', '(by constructor <;> norm_num)', '1', '(by norm_num)'], False, 'have key : ∀ (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 2) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε), 0 < x * Real.exp (-x) ∧ (∃ y ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 2, y * Real.exp (-y) < x * Real.exp (-x)) ∧ ∃ y ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 2, y * Real.exp (-y) < ε := by
  intro x hx ε hε
  have hf : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → y * Real.exp (-y) < y := fun y hy => by
    have : Real.exp (-y) < 1 := Real.exp_lt_one_iff.2 (by linarith)
    nlinarith
  have hpos : 0 < x * Real.exp (-x) := mul_pos hx.1 (Real.exp_pos _)
  refine ⟨hpos, ⟨min (x * Real.exp (-x)) 1 / 2, ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩, ?_⟩,
    ⟨min ε 1 / 2, ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩, ?_⟩⟩
  · have := min_le_right (x * Real.exp (-x)) 1; linarith
  · have h1 := hf (min (x * Real.exp (-x)) 1 / 2) (by positivity)
    have h2 := min_le_left (x * Real.exp (-x)) 1
    linarith
  · have := min_le_right ε 1; linarith
  · have h1 := hf (min ε 1 / 2) (by positivity)
    have h2 := min_le_left ε 1
    linarith
exact @key (1/10) ((by constructor <;> norm_num)) (1) ((by norm_num))'),
    (['19/10', '(by constructor <;> norm_num)', '1/100', '(by norm_num)'], False, 'have key : ∀ (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 2) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε), 0 < x * Real.exp (-x) ∧ (∃ y ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 2, y * Real.exp (-y) < x * Real.exp (-x)) ∧ ∃ y ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 2, y * Real.exp (-y) < ε := by
  intro x hx ε hε
  have hf : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → y * Real.exp (-y) < y := fun y hy => by
    have : Real.exp (-y) < 1 := Real.exp_lt_one_iff.2 (by linarith)
    nlinarith
  have hpos : 0 < x * Real.exp (-x) := mul_pos hx.1 (Real.exp_pos _)
  refine ⟨hpos, ⟨min (x * Real.exp (-x)) 1 / 2, ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩, ?_⟩,
    ⟨min ε 1 / 2, ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩, ?_⟩⟩
  · have := min_le_right (x * Real.exp (-x)) 1; linarith
  · have h1 := hf (min (x * Real.exp (-x)) 1 / 2) (by positivity)
    have h2 := min_le_left (x * Real.exp (-x)) 1
    linarith
  · have := min_le_right ε 1; linarith
  · have h1 := hf (min ε 1 / 2) (by positivity)
    have h2 := min_le_left ε 1
    linarith
exact @key (19/10) ((by constructor <;> norm_num)) (1/100) ((by norm_num))'),
]
